resources.string: Maintains an overlay view for screen dimming and blue light filtering to reduce eye strain during night use. Nyx never reads your screen content.
The filter is off, but the accessibility service is still running in the background.

Nyx requires Accessibility permissions to apply the screen filter over the entire system, including the navigation bar and lock screen.\n\nTap the button below, find Nyx in the list and turn the service on.

If Nyx is greyed out in that list (Android 13+, installed outside the Play Store): tap it once and dismiss the warning, then open App info, tap the three-dot menu and choose Allow restricted settings (it only appears after that first attempt), then try again.
Nyx is enabled but hasn\'t connected. Some phones stop accessibility services in the background. Turn Nyx off and on again in Accessibility settings.
Nyx could not draw the screen overlay, so the service was turned off.\n\nReason: %1$s
